Rationale.DE1_ResultFidelity: The replication was conducted as a demo-only case using the smaller Llama-3-8B model (32 layers) instead of Llama-3-70B (80 layers). The payload experiment results match the expected pattern: IIA rises from 0 to 1.0 in the final ~25% of layers (layers 26-30, which is 81-94% of model depth). This is proportionally consistent with the original finding that payload localizes after layer 56 (~70% of 80 layers). The documentation accurately reports limitations and does not misrepresent results.
Rationale.DE2_ConclusionConsistency: The replicated documentation presents conclusions consistent with the original. It correctly states the main hypothesis about lookback mechanisms, affirms that payload localization occurs in later layers (matching the original finding), and appropriately qualifies that full replication requires larger models. No contradictions or omissions of essential claims were found.
Rationale.DE3_NoExternalInformation: All information in the replicated documentation is traceable to original documentation or replication outputs. Paper reference (arXiv:2505.14685) appears in original CodeWalkthrough.md. Dataset details match the repository's data/ directory. Reported metrics (accuracy=10%, payload peak IIA=1.0, peak layers=26,28,30) are verified against replication_results.json. No external references or hallucinated information detected.
